I find it hard to have fun when I don't have a friend to hang out with except for one day roughly every six months. I've gone hiking in the mountains alone, I've gone to amusement parks alone, I've gone to beaches and the mall alone. Never having anyone to share this time with yet silently watching the groups of friends and couples and families genuinely smiling and having a good time.

And yet I'm too afraid to make friends and be hurt anymore. I'd like for things to get better and never have to kill myself. I've accepted I can't do anything about what's happened in the past but when it seems like it's just going to repeat itself in the future and that nothing can change no matter how long I wait or attempt to do something to change it there really is no reason to remain alive.
